detached_structure.evidence: A small deck or patio area with a dark object sits on the west side of the house, but it appears attached to the house and is not clearly a separate structure.

signals.notes: Lot has a gray-roofed house with two vehicles (a white one and a gray/silver one) parked on the right side, a side deck, and mature trees covering the southwest and east portions of the yard; the roof looks somewhat worn with shadows from adjacent trees.
